show.name: Jack of All Trades, Party of None
show.summary: Betrayed by his childhood friend and cast out of the Hero Party, Orhun Dura—once their loyal Enchanter—is branded by his former comrades as "a jack-of-all-trades but a master of none." Alone, he sets out to forge a new path as a solo adventurer. His journey sparks explosive battles, deadly rivals, and unexpected allies—and he'll rise to shatter every expectation. The ultimate solo comeback begins!
